collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-27  -  THE QUIET APOLOGY SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A villager realizes that an impatient remark during morning work hurt a friend's feelings.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A villager realizes that an impatient remark during morning work hurt a friend's feelings.

choices.label: Ask How to Avoid Repeating the Mistake.
Give the Friend Space Before Approaching.
Change the Behavior Before Expecting Reconciliation.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The friend accepts the apology but asks for some time alone.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The friend explains why the remark hurt, and the villager listens carefully.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The friends agree to speak more clearly when work becomes stressful.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The conversation remains awkward, but the villager understands the problem better.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They speak calmly later in the day and begin repairing their friendship.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The friend is not ready to talk, and the villager respects the boundary.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Over several workdays, the friend notices the villager becoming more considerate.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The friendship remains strained, but the villager continues practicing patience.
